ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity (white) and 25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the center of both visible lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation defines the trailing edge boundary and lobe tips. Discrete black circular clusters are concentrated near the peduncle attachment and scattered on the lower right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 30 degrees.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, dark circular pixel clusters near the median notch and isolated dark clusters on the right lobe's white surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions traversing the mid-section of the upper lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular dark pigmentation and jagged contour disruption at the extreme tip of the upper lobe; dark cluster marking at the base of the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'feathered' pattern where black pigmentation from the trailing edge extends into the white field in thin, distinct filaments on the upper lobe.
